correctness.rationale: For 2n-vertex cubic GP(n,2), crossing edges give |D|>=n; equality is precisely a perfect matching cut. Encode every column in two bits. The 256-state directed de Bruijn graph checks the exact crossing-degree-1 condition, and a full Tarjan enumeration proves precisely two singleton loops and two primitive five-cycles are cyclic. Every cyclic n-word is a closed walk entirely within one such component, yielding two constant sets and ten 5-periodic sets only when 5 divides n. The supplied executable verifies the entire finite lemma plus direct independent enumeration n=5..10.

value.rationale: Gives exact all-parameter minimum-solution census for the canonical GP(n,2) family and, equivalently, a complete classification of perfect-matching boundaries. The nontrivial period-five jump 2 vs 12 distinguishes the Petersen/dodecahedral congruence cases despite an unchanged optimum weight. This is structurally richer than a routine bound and links two independently motivated graph invariants.
